fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 14 ft aluminum fishing boat with trailer.
findings: Dull, hazy aluminum along the port hull sides and gunwale above the red paint
Dirt and debris in the bilge and on the floor between the seats
Faded, slightly chalky red paint on the lower port hull
Grime and spotting on the inside hull walls and under the seats
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1957 Larson Crestliner and the redone wood looks great. The aluminum sides are a bit hazy and the red paint on the lower hull looks faded, and the floor between the seats has some dirt in it. We do mobile pre-sale cleanups and polish work and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
